**Proposal Details:**

**Game: **Valorant by Riot games

To conduct a gaming tournament with a winning prize given in $EDG.

The gaming community is vast and highly competitive. So we would like to utilize this
environment to drive a new set of communities to the Edgeware Ecosystem.

The gaming world is always active and growing which could bring more versatile 
engagement.

We believe that bringing different types of communities could benefit Edgeware
in the long run, it will provide new opportunities for the chain.



**Tournament Conducting Plan:**

Looking to have a maximum of 8 teams be selected from the qualifiers and to 
be played in a knockout format.

We will be reaching out to the players through existing gaming communities, 
Influencers, and social media platforms.

We will also be streaming on Edgeware twitch.tv and highlights will be uploaded to YouTube.
The competition will be commentated on by Sharkoo and Gmeister.
** **
**GOAL:**

To have an active gaming community within Edgeware DAO that will open opportunity
for other communities to make their way into the ecosystem.

We also picture Edgeware to have teams to be sponsored that could potentially 
Compete in E-Sports tournaments globally.
